description: Search a library of UK Parliament video clips by what was actually said. Describe an idea in plain language, or give the distinctive words you remember, and Parliament Connect returns matching clips with the speaker, their party, the sitting date, a transcript excerpt and a shareable video link. Use it to find a quote you half-remember, check whether an MP has spoken on a topic, or pull up the footage behind a debate. Searching covers the MPs included in your Parliament Connect plan, and you sign in with your existing account.

defaultPrompt: Find clips where MPs criticised water companies over sewage discharges
What did the Chancellor say about the fuel duty freeze?
